testimonials.quote: Stemora completely transformed how our students engage with science. Watching 6th graders assemble and code their first functional robot was an incredible sight.
My son used to be glued to video games. After attending Stemora’s RoboCircuit workshop, he spent the entire weekend building breadboard circuits and explaining them to us!
The curriculum is exceptionally structured. Their instructors bring all materials, provide hands-on mentorship, and our teachers learned so much alongside the students.
testimonials.role_school: STEM Department Head, St. Joseph’s Boys’ High School
